Date prepared:  August 27, 2025  Meeting date: September 3, 2025

Subject:  Fiscal Year 2025-26 Deferred General Fund Grants

RECOMMENDED ACTION: Provide a recommendation to the City Council concerning
deferred applications of the General Fund Grant Program.

DISCUSSION: On June 11, 2025, the Administration and Finance Subcommittee
convened to review and provide recommendations to the City Council regarding the
allocation of the City’s annual General Fund Grants. On June 23, 2025, the City Council
adopted the Fiscal Year 2025-26 Budget, which included the approved General Fund
Grant allocations. A summary of the approved grant awards is provided in Attachment A.
As part of the June 23 action, several funding requests were deferred for further
consideration by the full City Council.

  Subcommittee
  Organization Name  Amount Requested
  Recommendation
 Friends of Malibu Urgent Care  $100,000  Defer to Council
 LAEPF - Community Brigade  $100,000  Defer to Council
 Malibu Education Foundation  $315,000  Defer to Council
 Mission Nirvana Malibu  $100,000  Defer to Council

Staff recommends that the Administration and Finance Subcommittee review the
deferred General Fund Grant Program applications and provide a recommendation to
the City Council for final action.
